A.description: Frontend-neutral backend. Applied for every frontend target (livewire, react, vue, svelte).

B.description: Builders: framework-agnostic menu/breadcrumb data-structure classes consumed by the frontend layer.

C.description: Frontend-coupled screens: Livewire components, Blade views, and view component classes. Skipped/replaced for Inertia (react/vue/svelte) targets.

D.description: Route modules. Applied conditionally per route_modules classification below.

A-meta.description: Root meta files: project documentation, Claude Code assets, and git housekeeping. Frontend-neutral but not application code.

exceptions.note: Category A by directory rule, but contains a Livewire/Flux-coupled registration section. Build tool must strip or guard that section for non-Livewire targets.
Mail layout view referenced by backend Mailables (App\Mail). Category C by directory rule, but required by category A code; keep for non-Livewire targets or replace with an equivalent mail layout.
Notification mail template referenced by backend Notifications. Same keep-or-replace caveat as mail/default-mail.blade.php.
Notifications screen is Livewire-coupled (pairs with routes/web/notifications.php, which is livewire_only). Skip together with that route module.
Published media-manager Livewire views (app-owned browser.blade.php hosts <x-breadcrumbs />). Skip for Inertia targets alongside routes/web/media.php.
Classified A (build config, not framework-specific), but its content globs reference resources/views; harmless when views are absent, prune globs if desired.
